work.text: Center of the altarpiece consisting of 14 panels with 26 episodes from Christ's Passion
work.lead: On the back of the Maestà:

work.text: we cannot ask for clearer localisation than is here given ; the inner court and chambers, the staircase running up [the side of the house], the space where the men are sitting — all are perfectly detached from one another, and each has ample depth.
work.lead: Berenson on the space of the courtyard:

source.author: Bernard Berenson
source.title: The Central Italian Painters of the Renaissance

moment.text: Duccio was also one of the first painters to put figures in architectural settings, as he began to explore and investigate depth and space.

matters.text: We see a group of men in the open air huddling about a fire, and bending over with hands outstretched to catch its glow. Peter in the midst is denying Christ, as the serving-maid passes by.

source.author: Bernard Berenson
source.title: The Central Italian Painters of the Renaissance
